userns.firstLine: browserType.launch: Target page, context or browser has been closed
userns.bywayWouldSay: The page renderer could not start (Target page, context or browser has been closed), so pages, and the cards that show a reviewer the examples beside the work, cannot be drawn. If Playwright's Chromium is not installed: pnpm --filter ./apps/web exec playwright install chromium
